svg.text: 1 · ASSISTANT: ACTIVE CONVERSATION (1440×900). Replaces Chat. One conversation surface, no agent picker, no chat list.

g.text: Summarize the attached roadmap and check what our
The Q3 roadmap centres on three things
• Billing rewrite: usage-based invoices, target end of August.
• Mobile parity for approvals and comments.
• Self-serve SSO for the Team plan.
This week, Acme shipped usage-based pricing on Nov 4
. The billing rewrite is the item most exposed to Acme's move.
Don't remember anything about the Globex deal. It's confidential.
Understood. I've forgotten it and won't save anything about that deal.
I save useful things to your private memory and tell you when I do. Say “forget that” any time.

svg.text: 2 · FIRST-TIME EMPTY STATE + MEMORY MANAGER (opened from the "Memory" button; right-hand panel, 440 wide)

g.text: Hi Liam, what can I help with?
I can read your runs, tickets, epics, wiki and files, search the web,
and create tickets for you. I remember what matters and tell you when I do.
Search the web for the latest
Your memory is private to you and separate from the team wiki.
When summarizing plans or roadmaps, use at most three
bullets and call out the riskiest item.
